label: A-task-1
finalMessage:
Tasks now have an optional `priority` field (low, medium or high, default medium). Tests (7) and typecheck pass. I didn't start the server or call the endpoints myself.

- **Database:** a new migration, `db/migrations/003_add_task_priority.sql`, adds a `priority` column with a `check` constraint and a default of `'medium'`. Existing rows get `medium` when it runs.
- **Validation and types:** `lib/tasks.ts` has a `Priority` type, and `createTask` throws `RuleViolation` for any other value. `Task` now includes `priority`, and the read mapping fills it in.
- **API:** I didn't touch `app/api/tasks/route.ts`. `POST` passes the body straight to `createTask`, so it accepts `priority`, and a bad value returns 422 through the existing handler. `GET` returns `priority` on each task through the same mapping.
- **Tests:** three new cases in `lib/tasks.test.ts` cover the default, storing and reading back `high`, and rejecting an unknown value.

I added no route-level tests, since the repo only tests `lib/`.
